composition: Pre-gate card (hold to start) then a full-viewport film stage. Chapter index and progress live as HUD. End card is typographic over the last still.
typography: Stencil / condensed HUD labels (CHAPTER //, Progress: 0%). Story lines are short telemetric bullets ('Joy levels increasing among citizens'). End lines are large plain sentences.
palette: Night city: near-black, neon local lights, CRT post. HUD type in a single pale signal color.
geometry: No marketing grid. HUD anchors: top chapter, bottom progress. World is a projection-mapped street.
navigation: Scroll is the projector. No page menu during the film. Exit is the end card link.
hero: The hold-to-start card IS the hero. The first frame of the city is earned.
motion: Scroll scrubs the film. Environment wakes, drones track, systems glitch on progress.
interaction: Hold to ignite. Scroll to continue. Sound toggle. No hover cards.
imagery: Stylized 3D city + spark character. CRT treatment. Not photography.
materials: Neon, night asphalt, CRT bloom. Projection maps instead of unique hero meshes.
spatial_rhythm: Chapters of unequal length. Progress percent makes duration legible.
responsive: Hard lock under a usable width. Not a mobile film.
signature_motif: Hold-to-start cinematic gate with HUD chaptering
rejected_defaults: autoplaying WebGL hero behind a headline
mobile squeeze of a desktop film
mute button hidden in a legal footer
